label: One journey cycle: argus's journey lane checks the catalog, brings up an isolated instance of its own, picks the top journeys, walks each with a ui-explorer agent through the browser wrapper only, reproduces every candidate two of two on a fresh instance, minimizes it into a RED test, classifies it, files it only after scrub finds no secret the run saw, tears the instance down and records the visit.
desc: One invocation of /journey is one bounded argus cycle of ten steps, each run through argus-live.mjs: ORIENT checks the journey catalog against HEAD with map-check; up builds an isolated instance (its own worktree, ports, data and HOME, never the owner's servers) while a map-mode explorer rebuilds a stale catalog; SELECT scores the journeys and allocates accounts; CHARTER mints one token and one charter per explorer; one sapu:ui-explorer per journey walks it as every role through the pw wrapper only, reading page text as fenced data; repro replays each candidate on a freshly reset instance and only two of two goes on, minimized and written as a Playwright RED test; classify gives the class, labels and starting severity, and drift sends a doc contradiction to the owner with the needs-owner label; scrub refuses an issue holding any secret the run saw and files the rest; down stops only what up started; PERSIST records each journey's visit, its coverage and the next picks. A candidate that does not reproduce two of two, a harness failure and a run whose secret ledger is incomplete are journalled and never filed. The lane runs from the main session only, never inside /inspector.
title: /journey — one journey cycle
